descricao: The houses of Level 9 appear to be furnished and fairly new, although there is no power source for the lighting systems to function. Some houses have a chance of being empty. Many useful objects, such as Pockets, can be found inside these houses and areas similar to them. The furniture of these houses is what a person would expect from a normal house, such as sofas, televisions, beds, refrigerators, etc. Items that require a power source are not functional. Some of these houses have fully furnished yards at the back of the house.
entidades: The Mangled, Deathmoths, Smilers, Skin-Stealers, Hounds, Transporters, Death Rats, Warning Kites, Wretches, The Arachnids
